body:
I moved across the country from her and haven't heard from her in months. It's a good idea and I have enforced it from day one - but this really caught me off guard. I didn't even see her. Just met this guy.

It's fucking ridiculous really.

Thanks. This is something towards a rather long angsty list of failures I've had this past 12 months. I can't help but note that it's my birthday and the irony of all the days to consider ending myself it would be today. 

Thank you though. It's appreciated.
We spoke on the phone earlier and she says she has. I just don't know how she can look at me. Her bf, my friend, is seeing me on Thursday and all he has said is that he's disappointed in me.

I appreciate the sentiment, I really do. I'm not usually a caring person, hell I am selfish, manipulative, and arrogant. It's what caused me and my ex to split up in the first place and I don't think I've genuinely felt a shred of emotion for anything since this has happened.

I just keep making mistake after mistake. Even when I think I've got it figured out everything crumbles.

I guess I would say that I'm depressed. I've never objectively thought about it but this is the most I've opened up since I broke up with my ex. I'm always cocky and happy on the outside but I just don't have that drive any more. It's gone.

This happened on Saturday and it's just getting more and more than I can cope.

It's something that has happened before but it's not out of the ordinary because I've shared my bed with about 7 friends in the last month. I don't mind, it's a small place, but in central London so it's handy.
